messages:
Maya (oncall): incidentbot paging: multiple 429 spikes in canary eu-west-1 for /v1/generate — customer-facing errors reported
DevOps Bot: :rotating_light: Alert: rate_limit_spike - canary-eu-west-1 - 09:12:03 UTC
Samir Patel: on it. what's the hypothesis? rollout or config drift?
Maya (oncall): initial: rl-v3 rollout looks like it's not honoring tenant exemptions, so legacy tokens are getting throttled
Lina Gomez: are these 429s persistent or transient? which customers affected?
Maya (oncall): persistent for ~5m at first noise. CS reports Acme, Byteware, and a few internal test clients failing
Raj (Customer Success): Acme on the line. they're seeing 429s on all long-running calls. Asked for ETA, gave a quick "we're investigating"
Marcus (infra): checking token-accounting ledger now. running quick query:
```
SELECT tenant_id, sum(requests) AS reqs, sum(allowed) AS ok FROM token_ledger WHERE ts > now() - interval '15 minutes' GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY reqs DESC LIMIT 20;
```
Marcus (infra): result: several tenants show reqs > 1k and ok == 0 — exemptions not applied
Samir Patel: if exemptions aren't applied we should kill the new ratecap path in canary. can someone flip the feature flag?
Maya (oncall): agreed. kill-switch for rl-v3 in canary region. Marcus, can you push?
Marcus (infra): yep. going to run the infra flag command:
```
./flags set rl-v3-enable false --env canary-eu-west-1
```
DevOps Bot: DeployBot started job 4572 to flip rl-v3-enable in canary-eu-west-1
DevOps Bot: DeployBot: job 4572 completed successfully (18s)
Samir Patel: check traffic now — any improvement?
Customer Success - Raj: Acme reports partial recovery, error rate dropped but still seeing ~10% 429s on some endpoints
Maya (oncall): ok still degraded. I'm going to revert the canary commit that introduced the token accounting change — we need ledger consistency
Samir Patel: preparing revert PR and will coordinate with Marcus for DB-level hotfix if needed
Marcus (infra): also applying a targeted hotfix to re-enable exemptions in the ledger: 
```
UPDATE exemptions SET active = true WHERE rule = 'legacy-token-exempt' AND env = 'canary-eu-west-1';
```
Marcus (infra): hotfix applied, monitoring ledger rebuilds.
Samir Patel: watching logs for token drift. searching for 429 signatures in ingress logs:
```
grep "status=429" /var/log/proxy/canary-eu-*(2026-03-01).log | wc -l
```
Lina Gomez: we should also automate a pre-rollout smoke that queries a small set of known-exempt tenants to validate exemptions before flipping flags
Maya (oncall): agreed, add to follow-up. Marcus, any metric numbers?
Marcus (infra): 429s dropped from 18% -> 2% over 6 minutes after flag flip + DB hotfix. latency unchanged.
Samir Patel: good. I'll land the revert PR with a patch that fixes the exemptions reconciliation and adds a unit/integration test.
Raj (Customer Success): sending update to customers now: "We've identified a deploy issue causing erroneous rate limits for some customers; we've rolled back the change and applied a hotfix. Monitoring continues — will follow up with a full incident report"
Maya (oncall): severity: sev2. impacted ~12 customers. creating incident doc and starting timeline notes
DevOps Bot: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by Samir Patel
PagerDuty: On-call handover scheduled to Marcus (infra) at 09:40 UTC
Maya (oncall): Handoff notes: Marcus you're on mitigation. Samir will handle revert PR / root-cause. Raj -> customer comms. Lina -> postmortem owner for rollout safeguards.
Marcus (infra): taking over. continuing to monitor token_ledger backfill and exemption rows.
Samir Patel: revert PR opened: revert/rl-token-accounting-canary + tests. Will request review from Marcus and Lina.
Lina Gomez: postmortem action items: 1) add canary smoke that validates exemptions, 2) add integration test for token_accounting reconciliation, 3) tighten canary rollout gating to include 5min customer-error check, 4) add alert that triggers when 'allowed' drops to 0 for a tenant
Maya (oncall): timeline for doc: 09:12 alert -> 09:15 flag flip -> 09:22 revert + DB hotfix -> 09:38 429s mostly mitigated.
DevOps Bot: IncidentBot created INC-2026-334 and attached timeline
Samir Patel: closing updates: will push follow-up PRs, Marcus please confirm when ledger fully reconciled and we can re-run a limited canary with patch.
Marcus (infra): ledger reconciled at 09:51 UTC, no remaining zero-allowed tenants. ready for a conservative redeploy when Samir gives the ok.
Maya (oncall): thanks all. please add any missing notes to the incident doc. I'll hand this back to platform for the postmortem. :thumbsup:
